Ordering and Shipping
Frequently Asked Questions
When does my order ship? How can I track a package?

We are a uniquely small operation, and with limited staff, we generally ship packages on Mondays and Wednesdays. For special holiday seasons, orders do go out more frequently. By placing an order on the website, you provide an email address; this allows us to send you an update the evening your package(s) ships. This email contains a tracking number for your package(s), so you can easily track progress. 

Do you ship to PO Boxes? Do you ship internationally?

We do not currently ship to PO Boxes or Military addresses. Expedited shipping via our carrier, UPS, will not deliver to PO Boxes or Military addresses. We are currently only shipping products to physical addresses within the continental United States, Alaska, and Hawaii. If you are interested in speciality shipping, or an international order for merchandise (not beef), please send us a message via our contact page. 

Can I place an order when I am outside the United States?

Unfortunately our website cannot accept orders from international IP addresses at this time. Also, for specialty orders done via email or phone, we are unable to process international credit cards or orders originating from an international IP address. 

What is your return policy?

Our beef is a perishable product, so we do not take returns. However, if you are unsatisfied in any way with any of our beef products, please contact us and we will do all we can to make your experience with 6 Ranch a pleasant one. For any other 6 Ranch merchandise (t-shirts, hats, etc.) we are happy to do exchanges or refunds. Please contact us to initiate a return or exchange.

Besides the 6 Ranch website, where else can I find 6 Ranch products?

Beyond 6Ranch.com, our beef is available in local stores around Wallowa County. Our website will have the most up-to-date list of retail locations. Please also check our social media channels (linked in the footer) for local events and opportunities when we take this beef show on the road. 

How do I place a wholesale order for my restaurant or retail store?

We would love to speak with you about carrying 6 Ranch products in your restaurant or store. Please call us at 541-398-0446, or send us a message via our wholesale page.

Who is your shipping carrier? Can I choose an alternate shipment option?

We use FedEx as our shipping partner; they have worked well for us. For shipping efficiencies, we aren’t able to offer an alternate option at this time.

Extreme Weather and Shipping

We ship our beef frozen, in well-insulated containers (with additional cooling materials only when needed). Please be aware that extreme temperatures may impede the quality of our product shipped to you. Our Grassroots Beef Club shipments can handle most seasonal weather (October – March) during transport in our limited shipping area (noted on the product page). In the unlikely event that weather is forecast to be extremely hot during this period, we will delay shipment. However, if weather turns unexpectedly and extremely warm, this can affect the product quality during shipment. In these instances, the shipping carrier does not warranty the goods.

Contact Us for Order Questions

The form on the contact page lets us help you faster. Please include your order number and details so we can be in touch.

Can I update my email address on my account?

Unfortunately, no. It’s one thing our website's account profile system does not allow for changing right now. You can update your shipping address and payment card tied to an existing account email address. If you’d like to use a new email address for future orders, please create a new user account at checkout. If you need assistance with an order associated with an old email address, go to the contact page for support. Please include any order details (number, etc.) when sending your message.

RANCHING ON PURPOSE.
Since 1884, five generations of our family have taken care of the land, river and animals that have sustained us here.
Our daily work revolves around tending to our fortunate place here with everything we’ve got. We believe in upholding western traditions, restoring ecosystems and producing healthy food.

Cattle are key to making it happen. Their grazing keeps weeds and undesirable plants in check, giving native grasses more room to thrive. They knead the soil where they move, replenishing nutrients for the long haul — no toxic chemical “enhancements” needed.   

Alongside that work: more work. Restoring rivers to their natural course to enhance salmon spawning habitat; improving wetlands and riparian areas. Clearing invasive juniper from acres of rangeland on the slopes around us. 

The reward: 100% grass-fed beef, born and bred humanely, for people that value who their food comes from as much as where it comes from.

“True.”
If ever a place could be called something more than home, this would be it. Something older, wiser, even more elemental. A place we are born of, not just in.
The land we’re on — we can’t claim to own. Our arrangement plays out in daily tests of wills and wonder and laws bigger than words. Both parties would probably agree on that.
We are grounded to its soil and stones. Water, wood, and wind; animals and energies. A timeless and beautiful coexistence with What Is. 
Part of a silent and irrevocable pact struck some six generations ago. To respect its ways. Let its real nature be, uninterrupted. Wild, and rightfully so.  
This is our work here: To put back what we use. Set right what’s not. Honor our place; the traditions and the experience we’ve been given. 
In exchange, this land provides. 
It teaches. 
And working together, it endures.  
6 Ranch. True.
Why Corrientes are right for us.  

This is a breed with real history to it, known for being especially hardy and naturally lean.

MEET THE FAM
Meet the wildlife in the water.

Several years ago, 6 Ranch completed two important habit restoration projects on a nearby stretch of the Wallowa River. Returning this sensitive area to its natural state gave native plants, insects, fish, and wildlife the home they were meant to have.  

It’s a perfect spot to experience how a balanced ecosystem works. And from July – September, we offer guided fly-fishing trips here. If you really want to experience this land’s greatness, come stand in its water.

WHOLESALE WELCOME.
Restaurants, pubs, retailers: let's cook something up together.
A burger with real 
meat to it starts here.
Premium quality, with a unique pedigree. Make way, Waygu — our Corriente cows deliver the best modern American burger around, naturally lean and flavorful. Over 20 years of partnering with restaurants says so. 
We do whole carcass grind for 6 Ranch ground beef. Processing one animal at a time allows total traceability of 100% grass-fed goodness at its best. All our ground beef is delivered frozen, for freshness and handling. 
Corriente: Beef with a bigger benefit.
Our Corriente cattle are key players in regenerative ag and sustainable land practices. Compact frames and resourceful character make them easy partners with the land — coexisting with our environment as naturally as wildlife does. They are straight up productive range cattle, unspoiled by over-domestication problems that hobble larger, heavier, conventional cows. 
The reward: 100% grass-fed beef, born and bred humanely, for people that value who their food comes from as much as where it comes from.   
We love a big, fatty rib steak, too. But there’s something about a well-rounded burger that keeps us saddled up and doing what we do every day.
